rules.notes: Attach language=en unless the path begins docs/es/; attach language=es beneath docs/es/.
Resolve only when referenced by an included page; do not emit standalone prose chunks by default.
Retain as structured metadata if referenced; do not emit standalone prose chunks by default.
Preserve and register for compliance, but do not ingest as wiki content.
Retain for link resolution and future OCR decisions; exclude from this textual pilot.
Theme, presentation, CI, governance, and site-build dependencies are outside primary retrieval.
Record in inventory but do not ingest.

normalization_notes_for_next_task: Parse YAML front matter before headings.
Resolve supported Liquid includes with cycle and path guards.
Preserve tables and fenced code as atomic structures where practical.
Strip repeated Back-to navigation lines from chunk text while retaining link metadata.
Keep English and Spanish documents in separate language-aware retrieval metadata.
Treat redirects as aliases, not independent duplicate content.
Use special handling for oversized reference pages and very small index/placeholder pages.
